system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In February 2026, Thanakrit lent a friend 80,000 baht without any mention of interest, repayable within one year. The friend repaid in full and on time. Is Thanakrit entitled to claim interest for that one-year period? Answer only "entitled" or "not entitled", with a one-sentence reason.
raw_response: **Not entitled** — under Section 7 (and the loan provisions, Section 650 paragraph 2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, if the parties did not agree on interest, the lender cannot claim interest on the loan.
